title: Patient Payment Plan Credit for a Payment Made After the Offer
content:
**Rule.** A patient payment made after the offer on an account enrolled on the **Patient Payment Plan** offer is credited against the down payment, never below zero. The latest payment posted on any of the patient's hospital accounts in the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) (the first listed among payments of that date) counts when its posting date is after the offered date and its account is enrolled on the offer. When it pays at least the amount enrolled for that account, that enrolled amount is credited; when it is smaller, the payment itself is credited; otherwise nothing is credited.

| Latest payment on any of the patient's accounts | Credited |
|---|---|
| posted after the offered date, on an enrolled account, at least that account's enrolled amount | the account's enrolled amount |
| posted after the offered date, on an enrolled account, below that account's enrolled amount | the payment |
| posted on or before the offered date | nothing |
| on an account not enrolled on the offer | nothing |

**Hypothetical.** An offer made on 3 June enrolls an account at 150.00. A payment of 200.00 posted on that account on 10 June, the latest payment on any of the patient's accounts, credits 150.00; a payment of 60.00 would credit 60.00. If a later payment on 12 June went to an account not on the offer, it is the latest payment and nothing is credited. Against a down payment of 100.00, a credit of 150.00 leaves nothing due, never less than zero.
